lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Practice summarizing a short public-information text with clear source framing.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: Two adults discuss a municipal notice about changed library opening hours and services.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Summarizing the main point of a source and deciding whether it affects a plan.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik have read a short notice about temporary library changes and discuss what the notice means for their visit.

main_focus.name: source framing with enligt and det viktigaste är att
main_focus.description: Use short source-framing phrases to separate information from the source from the speakers' own reaction.
model_examples: Enligt informationen är biblioteket stängt på måndag.
Det viktigaste är att man måste boka tid i förväg.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use source-framing naturally 3-4 times in the dialogue.

allowed_supporting_grammar: subordinate clauses with att and eftersom
V2 word order after enligt informationen and därför
modal verbs for obligation and possibility
simple passive forms in public information

useful_chunks: Det verkar gälla från och med måndag.
vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use most active words naturally, with repeated exposure to source-framing chunks.

dialogue_shape.opening: One person mentions a municipal notice and the practical plan it may affect.
dialogue_shape.middle: They identify the main point, clarify one condition, and react to how the change affects them.
dialogue_shape.ending: They agree on a revised plan based on the notice.

target_complexity.repetition: repeat source-framing phrases enough for noticing without sounding mechanical

focus: the main point of the public information
the plan that changes because of the notice

sentence_focus: one sentence starting with enligt informationen
one sentence identifying the most important point
one sentence explaining how the notice affects a plan
one sentence with tillfälligt and öppettider
one sentence checking understanding of the source
